text:
Maya: Quick shoutout to Ops (Priya + Liam) for jumping on the staging flakiness during the client demo. Saved the day! :raised_hands:
Owen: absolute legend hours. Priya hopped in and fixed the config leak in like 20 mins. :star2:
Priya: team effort  the cache invalidation was sneaky. Thanks to Jasmine for the rollback script.
Jasmine: happy to help. also restocked the snack shelf with granola bars 95c for the late shift.
ops-bot: incident logged: staging-cache-leak | resolved by Priya, rollback by Jasmine | no customer impact. :white_check_mark:
Liam: planning a tiny appreciation thing: "sticker jar" next to the whiteboard 4dd48e 44d micro-shoutouts you can peel and stick. Thoughts?
Maya: love it. small gestures go a long way.
Owen: poll: :card_index: for handwritten notes, :label: for stickers. react to vote.
Priya: :label: 44c stickers are low friction and fun.
Jasmine: :label: + I can print a sheet of 50 that says "Saved the Demo" with a tiny robot icon.
Maya: volunteer to stick them on the board each week? I can take next Monday after standup.
Liam: I'll fund the sticker paper. Also adding a tiny jar of thank-you candies.
Owen: can we include a 1-line in Friday digest: "micro-win: ops fixed staging cache during client demo"? helps visibility.
Maya: done, adding note now. Also GIF suggestion: https://giphy.com/gifs/thank-you-heck-5xaOcLGvzHxDKjufnLW
Priya: thanks all 970 let's keep this going. Small rituals = big morale.
Jasmine: agreed. quick after-action: I'll add the rollback commands to the runbook and tag Priya for review.
Maya: perfect. Sticker jar in place by lunchtime tomorrow. :tada:
